# StayEdge — AI-Powered Airbnb Growth

## About
StayEdge helps Airbnb hosts, villas, and boutique hotels in India increase bookings through AI-powered listing optimisation, dynamic pricing, and guest-psychology-driven growth consulting. Founded in 2024 by Sanjay Stephen. Based in Tirupati, Andhra Pradesh.
